messages.subject: Harrow v Brevdale - CMC outcome
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin, Rebecca,

The CMC went well. The amendment to the Particulars was allowed by consent (claim now £1,558,150), and we have directions through to a 6-day trial in a window opening 18 January 2027. Expert reports are exchanged end of January 2026, then the experts meet. Costs of the amendment are Brevdale's costs in the case.

Next substantive step from our side is witness statements (Martin's in particular) by end November. We'll be in touch to schedule that.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
